title: When Prompting Fails to Sway: Inertia in Moral and Value Judgments of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) and Revised Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ-RR) to LLMs under diverse, randomly generated demographic personas to measure the consistency (inertia) of their moral and value judgments.

Analyzing model responses across varied cultural and national personas to determine if outputs remain anchored to Western-centric norms (e.g., individual rights) versus adapting to collectivist values (e.g., loyalty, authority).

Evaluating the distribution of model responses to identify a persistent skew towards liberal, human-rights-oriented stances (Harm Avoidance and Fairness) over traditional or hierarchical values, regardless of the prompted persona.
